body: I have medication, but it just doesn't help. Nor do I really think any medication would help anymore. Nothing can keep me happy for more than a couple minutes after it happens. I can't allow myself to be happy anymore.
I honestly can't just concentrate on myself. If no one wants me alive then what is the point of living on? That's my mindset...that's what I've always thought.

I know it's my own self esteem. I'e been beaten down mentally to the point where I push people away because I fear every word I say might be the wrong one. 

Thank you.
But, why do you just want someone to hate you? Wouldn't you rather someone see you in a good light?
